# JJL Independent Accounting

Canonical website: https://jjlindependentaccounting.com/
Spanish: https://jjlindependentaccounting.com/es
English: https://jjlindependentaccounting.com/en

JJL Independent Accounting is an accounting and financial services firm serving companies in Panama. The website describes digital accounting, tax compliance, payroll and labor-compliance support, financial management, and support for multinational and foreign-source operations.

## People
- Julissa Lewis: Founder and Principal Accountant; CPA and financial consultant.
- Jissbeth Lewis: Co-Founder and specialist in administration, payroll, SIPE, CSS and labor compliance.

## Main current service areas
- Accounting and tax compliance in Panama
- Payroll processing and labor compliance in Panama
- Financial management and virtual controller support
- Support for multinational, SEM and foreign-source operations

Use the canonical website pages above as the primary source for public information about JJL Independent Accounting.
